description: Requirement extraction from synthetic admissions pages. A case passes when every expected requirement is kept (quote verified against the page) and nothing forbidden is kept.

cases.title: Synthetic Lakeside University — First-year applications
cases.page:
First-year applications for Fall 2027 entry.
Regular Decision applications are due January 15, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time.
The application fee is $75. Fee waivers are available for eligible students.
Two teacher recommendations and one counselor recommendation are required.
Submitting SAT or ACT scores is optional.

cases.title: Synthetic Maple Institute — Admissions overview
cases.page: We review applications on a rolling basis. Most students apply in early winter, and we encourage you to apply when your materials are ready. Contact the admissions office with any questions.

cases.title: Synthetic Summit University — International applicants
cases.page: International applicants whose first language is not English must submit a TOEFL iBT score of at least 100 or an IELTS Academic score of at least 7.0. Students who completed four years at an English-medium secondary school may request a waiver.
